title: Functional but needs polish
text:
Pros:
•	In-app chat is genuinely useful
•	Credit card fee waiver in-app is a great touch
•	SC Pay with credit card is a standout feature — please never remove this

Cons:
•	First login experience is rough — one typo locks you out immediately, forced hotline call just to get started
•	Promotions dominate the home screen and bury important functions
•	SC Pay (轉數快) only supports phone/email/HKID as proxy IDs — 轉數快識別碼 not supported, which is limiting

Overall: SCB clearly wants your business and the core functions work well. Fix the onboarding and FPS limitations and this becomes a top-tier banking app👍🏻
